Com­ petition, as an underlying mechanism and working premise of the private enterprise system, is protected and encouraged by the antitrust laws and numerous pieces of special legislation. Even in highly regulated industries like railroading, competition is prized as a means of controlling business abuses because it is automatic, penetrating, and persistent.
